To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) organizing Web search results into categories is useful to users and 2) automatic categorization of search results is a viable way to provide this organization.
organizing search results into categories is a useful way to improve the efficiency of information retrieval.

1) users prefer to browse through a hierarchical category structure rather than a ranked list; 2) users find information faster when it is organized into categories; 3) users prefer the category interface to the list interface; and 4) the category interface is better for finding information in the long run.
